tvShow.name: Hijack
tvShow.overview: Expert negotiator Sam Nelson is in for the ride of his life—and so is everyone on board with him—after a group of hijackers take control. Sam will try every move in his playbook to take them down...as the stakes grow higher by the second.

episodes.name: Final Call
episodes.overview: Sam Nelson gets on a flight to London hoping to win back his ex-wife, but something on board feels wrong—and his suspicions are confirmed.

episodes.name: 3 Degrees
episodes.overview: Spotting an opportunity, Sam executes a plan to get a covert message to authorities on the ground.

episodes.name: Draw a Blank
episodes.overview: As the UK’s counterterrorism unit learns of Flight KA29, Sam gets involved in a risky plan to take on the hijackers.

episodes.name: Not Responding
episodes.overview: An incident team in Westminster scrambles to intercept fighter jets. Sam tries contacting the ground once more when a hijacker is injured.

episodes.name: Less Than an Hour
episodes.overview: Sam attempts to convince the hijackers to land the plane. A list of demands reveals who’s behind the hijacking.

episodes.name: Comply Slowly
episodes.overview: Faced with an impossible decision, the passengers ready themselves for a fight.

episodes.name: Brace Brace Brace
episodes.overview: A new threat emerges on board as Sam struggles to control the chaos unfolding around him.

episodes.name: Signal
episodes.overview: Two years after Flight KA29's hijacking, Sam Nelson is thrust into another life-threatening ordeal—but this time it's personal.

episodes.name: Control
episodes.overview: Sam urges Otto to keep his cool as passengers begin to suspect something is wrong. Police Chief Winter races to mount a response.

episodes.name: Baggage
episodes.overview: Berlin police scramble to contain the situation. Sam pressures Winter to meet his demands. Marsha discovers she's being watched.

episodes.name: Switch
episodes.overview: A shocking turn of events forces Sam to make a gesture of good faith. In London, Daniel calls on a friend to help look into what's happening in Berlin.

episodes.name: Outage
episodes.overview: Anger and frustration among the passengers begin to boil over—just as Sam comes to a frightening realization.

episodes.name: Junction
episodes.overview: To avoid further disaster, Sam must work with an unlikely ally. The enemy closes in on Marsha as Zahra and Daniel fear they've reached a dead end.

episodes.name: Contact
episodes.overview: Sam gambles on a dangerous tactic in hopes of outsmarting the police. Armed with new intel, Olivia tries to influence Winter's next move.

episodes.name: Terminal
episodes.overview: With the handover imminent, Sam is prepared to put his life on the line to save Marsha—and expose the truth.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In the second season, a Berlin underground train and its commuters are taken hostage, while authorities scramble to save hundreds of lives. Sam Nelson is at the heart of the crisis on board, where one wrong decision could spell disaster.

alternativeTitles.title: Hijack - Sette ore in alta quota

reviews.author: MovieGuys
reviews.content:
I came to this series predominantly because Idris Elba is the lead character. I'm a big fan of his work, so its somewhat disappointing not be able to offer a resounding endorsement, of Hijack.

I do feel that hijacking as a foundation, for a film, can work in 90 or so minutes of screen time. In a multi episodic,  series, I believe its a hard sell. How much can you make story wise of the confined conditions of an aircraft? 

As I'm seeing not a lot and the end result, unsurprisingly, starts to feel as exhausting and monotonous, as a long haul flight. Its not the actors fault, nor is it the writers, there's really only so much you can say. 

In summary, well acted but hamstrung by the basic premise the series is built upon. I personally think it would have worked a lot better as a 90 or so minute, made for TV film.
